tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (573)༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ // /
(573)༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (573)༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(574)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rjes khros pa'i sku// ma rungs bdud dpung phye mar thag mdzad pa// bla ma mgon po dbyer med zhabs pad la// gus pas btud nas sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri// rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rim pa mtha' dag legs par mnos pa zhig gis/ bris sku mchod gtor sogs mtshan nyid tshang bar bshams la/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ nang mchod byin rlabs yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar ram/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byas la/ gnas khang mchod rdzas gtor ma rnams la gtong a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las byung pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyi sngags dang*/ rol mo byin dbab spyi dang mthun par bya/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ /yaṃ las (575)rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum/ a las ka pā la dum bu gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar du go las ba lang gi sha /lhor ku las khyi'i sha /nub du da las rta'i sha /byang du ha las glang po che'i sha rnams hūm̐ bh+rūṃ āṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su mu las dri chu/ shar du bi las dri chen/ lho ru ra las rak+ta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las sha chen kyi dwangs ma rnams/ bāṃ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ gyis mtshan pa de rnams kyi steng du oṃ dkar po mgo bo mthur du bstan pa/

de'i steng du a las zla ba/ hūm̐ las rdo rje'am gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khel ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song ba/ oṃ dang hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag /hūm̐ gi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te thim/ oṃ yig zla ba rdo rje'am gri gug dang bcas pa lhung ste/ rdo rje'am gri gug gis lan gsum du dkrugs nas/ thams cad zhu ba gtor ma zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba (576)dharmaḥswa bhā lba shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang*/ mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du gaṃ dkar po 'od du zhu ba las// dpal tshogs kyi bdag po dkar po glang po che'i dbu la spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas sa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol pa/ g.yon ne'u le rin po che skyug pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ kha gshang ba spu'i khung bu rnams nas nor bu'i char 'bebs pa nyal stabs su gnas pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug 'bar ba hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnas pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ khong nas 'khrugs shing rngam pa'i zhal drag tu bzhad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang*/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/

dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thig les byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod pa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yas bar pas thod skam gyi phreng ba/ tha mas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na rdo rje'i zhags pa nag po bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis srid gsum rnam par gnon pa'i shugs can mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po gnon cing brdzis pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs la dar ljang gu'i ske rags bcings pa/ klu chen po'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ (577)sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing*/ dmar po'i snyan cha/ khra bo'i dpung rgyan/ dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang gu'i do shal/ dkar po'i rkang gdub dang ske rags can/ phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sbom thung lto ba rgyas shing yan lag hrags pa/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa la sogs pa 'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pas bdud dang dgra bgegs thams cad rlag par mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ tsan+dan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o// de'i g.yon du khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog nag mo rngam zhing khros pa// phyag g.yas kyis bdud kyi khram shing nag po phyar zhing*/ g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa/ chibs kyi snga long la sho rde'u dkar nag dang*/ byang dmar khres po/ phyi long la mtshon gyi gru gu ste sprul pa'i mtshon cha lnga dang bcas pa/

spyan gsum mche gtsigs khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dbu skra gyen du 'khyil zhing spyi bor rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan pa/ lte ba nas nyi ma dang spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ srin po'i ya mgal la sga'i snga ru byas shing ma mgal la phyi ru byas pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs dang gos nag gsol ba/ rus pa'i rgyan dang mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ me dpung dang rlung nag 'tshubs mar 'tshub pa'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ 'khor sha za dang*/ ma mo (578)mkha' 'gro 'bum sdes bskor ba'o/ gtso bo'i mdun du k+ṣiṃ las gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la sku mdog mthing nag kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung ldangs pa/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug nam mkha' la phyar bas lha dang lha min thams cad skrag par byed pa/ g.yon thod khrag dgra bgegs kyi snying dang bcas pa gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin gdug pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas su hūm̐ las dbang phyug dzī na mi tra/ sku mdog dmar nag srin po khros pa'i gzugs can/ zhal nas dug dang khrag gi char 'bebs pa/ phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la me 'bar ba/ 'khor gza' dang srin po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ rgyab tu ṭaṃ las gshin rje ṭa k+ki rā dza sku mdog nag po mi'i sha khrag la ches rngam pa/ phyag g.yas rgyu ma'i zhags pa dgra la 'phen cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub gnod byed la sdigs pa/ gshin rje'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ gsum ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ g.yon du hūm̐ las bdud mgon chen po trak+shad smu mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/

phyag g.yas su mtshon mdung dmar rtse gsum pa dgra bo'i snying khar bsnun pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba zhal du gsol ba/ ya sos ma mchu mnan cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber mun pa'i g.yung drung ris dang*/ sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol ba/ gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ 'khor lha dang bdud dmag gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ bzhi ka'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu lta ba/ mi bzad pa'i mche ba rnam pa bzhi gtsigs pa/ gtum zhing khros la cher 'khrugs pa/ 'jigs dang mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can sma ra dang smin (579)ma dang dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*// mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal can/ me rlung drag tu 'tshubs pa'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyi rol du shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar por skyes la zhon pa bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po smug nag ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang gu sha ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa nor bus mtshan pa'i be con 'dzin pa/ byang shar du 'byung po dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa lha mo so la 'khyud pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa bum pa 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa bdag nag po phag pa la zhon pa rin po che 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi rigs mtshungs 'bum 'bum gyis yongs su bskor ba phyag g.yon pas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o/ gzhan yang ma hā de ba la sogs pa lha chen po brgyad/ nor rgyas la sogs pa klu chen po brgyad/ nyi ma la sogs pa gza' chen po brgyad/

drag po la sogs pa 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ smin drug la sogs pa rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ yul 'khor srung la sogs pa rgyal po chen po bzhi ste/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga po thams cad kyang 'khor bye ba bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs lha ma srin sde brgyad rnams sha la dga' ba khrag la rol pa/ snying rje med pa/ kha gdangs pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ bzhin bsdus pa/ gtum zhing 'jigs la mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can/ lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa/ skad cig la skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog dbugs sdud pa/ (580)gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ sha za dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ bdud dang*/ ma mo'i cha lugs can/ sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su g.yog /thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i re 'dod tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ tsan+dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing*/ g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa/ bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig de nyid la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra si li li khro lo lo 'ur 'ur chem chem du byon par gyur/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā la che// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// k+ṣe tra pā la la sogs pa// 'khor gyi bka' nyan gnod sbyin tshogs// bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*// bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra k+ṣiṃ/

k+ṣiṃ ring po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ de nas k+ṣiṃ gi gnas su e h+ye hi bcugs pa dang*/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcug pa lan gsum gsum brjod pas/ myur mdzad 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar// byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas 'di ru// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim// pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba (581)yi// lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil= pā d+yaṃ= me tog= puṣ+pe= bdug spos= dhū pe= snang gsal= ā lo ke= dri chab= gan+dhe= zhal zas= nai wi d+ya= rol mo= shab+da= snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod 'bul/ chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku// bstan pa'i ru tra 'joms mdzad pa'i// nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas rgyun gyi nyams len gtor chog tsam bya bar 'dod na/ 'og gi gtor ma 'bul ba man chad byas pas kyang rung la/ yang bla ma mgon po dbyer med dang*/ grib sil dang*/ gnad dbab kyi bka' legs par thob cing*/ de dag gi don nyams su len par 'dod na/ dmigs pa dang gnad rgyas pa rnams man ngag ltar shes par byas la/ dang po bla ma mgon po'i gsol 'debs ni/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon gser gyi dril bu dkur brten pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje 'chang nas brtsams te brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma'i sku las 'od 'phros/

mgon po 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'ur 'ur/ sil sil gar mdzad/ mgon po las 'od 'phros/ bla ma'i sku la thim pas/ bla ma 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra sil sil/ khrol khrol gar mdzad/ bla ma nyid mgon po/ mgon po nyid bla ma/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med par gyur/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba (582)'debs so// mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs so// dpal ldan sha ba ri dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs so// mnga' bdag me tri pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs so// grub chen rā hu la chen po la gsol ba 'debs so// mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs so// mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus la gsol ba 'debs so// rtogs ldan zhang sgom chos seng la gsol ba 'debs so// dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs so// gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs so// 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa la gsol ba 'debs so// mkhas grub shangs ston chos rje la gsol ba 'debs so// khyung po tshul khrims mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so// bya bral ri khrod ras chen la gsol ba 'debs so// mkhyen ldan shangs pa dkar po la gsol ba 'debs so// mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs so// grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs so// rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs so// rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog la gsol ba 'debs so// chos sku lha dbang grags pa la gsol ba 'debs so// rje btsun tā ra nā tha la gsol ba 'debs so// rgyal tshab rin chen rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so// rgyal tshab ye shes rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so// mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs so// chos rje ngag dbang phrin las la gsol ba 'debs so// chos rje kun bzang dbang po la gsol ba 'debs so// rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la gsol ba 'debs so// bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta la gsol ba 'debs so// bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma la gsol ba 'debs so// bka' (583)brgyud phrin las rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs so// pad+ma nyin byed dbang po la gsol ba 'debs sa/

na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo bu ru he/ badz+ra bī ra bī ri ṇe/ shrī ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ dzo ga dzo gi nī/ sarba bud+dhā bodhi sa twa ya sha rā ṇī/ gats+tsha mi/ kyai phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs shig /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /bla ma mgon po dbyer med la// bdag ni dad pas gsol 'debs kyis// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus bsal ba dang*// dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/

/gnyis pa grib sel ni/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug tu rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa// g.yon pas mnyam gzhag gi steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ steng gi nam mkha' (584)la 'khod par gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas ba'i mthar/ rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan sha wa ri// rgyal ba mai tri grub chen rā hu la// a mi de ba lo ke shwa ra dang*// ha ya grī ba pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal// khyung po jo gi rat+na bīr+ya dang*// dharma siṃ ha dharma pra dzña dang*// bīr+ya siṃ ha shangs ston chos rje sogs// rin chen brgyud pa'i bla ma dgongs su gsol// 'gro ba'i re skong yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// brgyud ldan bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la// dag pa gnyis ldan chos skur ma rtogs pa// 'jig rten rtog bcas dbang gyur mthol lo bshags// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las dang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i lha rnams dgongs su gsol// bdag cag theg mchog sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas// rtsa ba yan lag 'gal nyams mthol lo bshags// mthu stobs nus pa phrin las phun tshogs shing*// skad cig dran pas bar chad thams cad sel// 'du 'bral med par dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// ye shes mgon po phyag drug dgongs su gsol// dur khrod nags mtha' chu gling bas mtha' ru/ phyi nang rten dang dam rdzas tshogs gyur nas// bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags tshul bzhin ma grub bar// le lo g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur mthol lo bshags// khyad par gsang ba'i rten mchog bla na med// bla ma mgon po dbyer med bde chen sku// khyod la yid ches mos gus 'bral med kyis// rnam dag chos skur ma rtogs mthol lo bshags// bdag ni ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te// bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa// gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas nas kyang*// lha mchog khyod kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags// ye shes bka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad// k+ṣe tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang*// ṭā k+ki rā dza trak+shad re ma ti// phyogs skyong bcu dang gtsang rigs dgongs su gsol// ji ltar khyed kyis (585)khas blang dam bcas bzhin// bdag gi phrin las yengs med sgrub pa la// yi chad bgyis shing sha khrag gtor tshogs kyis// gtong rag dus su ma thongs mthol lo bshags// mngon shes med pas nyes skyon ma rtogs par// bstan pa 'jig dang bla ma'i sku dgra la// drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod ma bgyis par// gsang ba bsgrags shing byams bgyis mthol lo bshags// dam nyams grib phog gtam 'dres zas zos dang*// rgyu chung phud nyams 'gal 'khrul nor la sogs// nyes skyon 'khrul pa'i tshogs rnams ci mchis pa// gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas mthol lo bshags// sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// tshor te dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// ma tshor dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// nyams grib dag phyir bshags pa 'di byas pas// bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// pha ma bu tsha bzhin du bzod bzhes la// dngos grub thams cad dus 'dir stsal du gsol// bshags dang bshags par bya ba ma dmigs kyang*// rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags dag bya'i phyir// rje btsun dam pa yul gyi mchog rnams la// rab tu bshags pas bde chen thob gyur cig

/gsum pa gnad dbab ni/ mgon po'i dbu gtsug gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid// sku mdog dmar po g.yas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*// g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa// bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can// sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa// chags pa'i nyams can// spyan gzigs pa tsam gyis mkha' 'gro dang srid gsum dbang du sdud pa// skyil krung gis bzhugs pa// mgon po'i (586)dpral ba'i sin+dhū ra'i thig le gru gsum gyi steng na yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ngo bo bcu gsum yongs su gyur pa las/ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lang tsho ma/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs can/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs shing gar mdzad pa bcu gsum sgrol ma'i ngo bo/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bdag gi dbang du bsdus/ dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin tu babs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra na ra kriṃ kriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ /ces pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba rnams kha dog nag po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ phreng rdog ltar gnas pa la/ 'od zer sna lnga phreng thag gi tshul du brgyus pa/ rang gi zhal nas thon/ mgon po'i zhal du zhugs pa mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ yang hūm̐ las byung*/ mgon po'i lte ba nas thon/ bdag gi lte bar zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ de ltar rtag tu 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bi gh+nān bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa dang*/ phaṭa gnyis dang*/ swā hā bsnan pa yi de nyer gnyis pa yang rung ste/ snying po ci 'grub bzlas/ drag po'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la shā sa na/

u pa hā ri ṇā+e/ e ṣo3pash+tsi ma kā lo3yaṃ e daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇi ya di pra ti dzña/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+na gṛh+na/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa ni drag sngags te/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum yang 'di la tshang bar bzhed do/ /oṃ shrī de bī hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha mo'i mtshan sngags so/ /bh+yo ma mo nag mo bai tā li sin+dha ku lu ku lu hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lha mo'i snying po'o/ /oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bi gh+nan hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na mi tra ba shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tā k+ki rā dza sa ma ya bh+yoḥdu dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ du yo ga dza (587)ma hā kā la trak+shad hūm̐ phaṭa/ las mkhan bzhi'i snying po'o// de ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub byas nas mthar/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma drangs nas gsol bas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas tshim nas dgyes par gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa'am/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bi gh+nan bi nā ya ka traka rag mo ba liṃ ta māṃ sa rak+ta ru dhi ra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ de bzhin du 'khor rnams la snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ /zhes pa btags la lan gsum gsum gyis phul/ ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gong ltar nang mchod phul la/ /hūm̐/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan// nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can// phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yas pas gri gug bar pas phreng ba 'dzin// tha mas ḍā ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol// g.yon pas thod pa dang ni mdung rtse gsum// de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed// drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs// spyan gsum drag po'i dbu skra gyen du 'bar// dpral bar sin+dhū ra yi thig les byugs// spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab brten// khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can// rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// shing las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang*// dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod pa dang*// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// ci 'dod dngos grub myur du stsal du gsol// lang ka pu ri gsum bsregs shing*// sangs rgyas bstan skyong bdud dpung 'joms// zhal gcig phyag drug nag po che// (588)'jigs pa'i gzugs can khyod la bstod// bh+yo/

khrag mtsho chil chil khol ba'i klong dkyil na// tsho chen dre'u'i steng na gzi brjid 'bar// mthing nag sku la zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// bdud kyi khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams// sku yi sprul pas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*// gsung gi sprul pas khams gsum g.yo bar byed// thugs ni mi 'gyur 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// ma gcig re ma ti la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po'i phyogs bzhi'i bka' nyan pa// ye shes bka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad// ma rungs kun 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed// las byed pho nya bzhi la bdag cag bstod// dbang po gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang*// me lha srin po rlung lha 'byung po dang*// steng gi tshangs pa sa yi lha mo ste// sprul pa'i phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*// dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams// sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol// mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang*// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /thun gtor yod na sgron me btsugs te khang steng la sogs par 'bul zhing*/ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la dang*// ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti// lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i// k+ṣe tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang*// ṭa k+ki rā dza bdud mgon tra k+shad sogs// dpal ldan nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dzam bu dwī pa'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phud 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtong rag gnyan por 'bul// da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes// 'khor rnams srung zhing rkyen rnams zlog pa dang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs// bdud dang bar (589)du gcod pa rnam mang po// thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod// bstan pa rgyas pa'i las ni myur du sgrubs// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/

/thun gtor med na rgyun gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs spyi bstab 'di bya mi dgos so/ yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshangs dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya min gang bgyis pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs// bla ma mgon po dbyer med la// bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus sel bar shog /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam btab/ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin// byin rlabs chu bos skal bzang tshims mdzad cing*// rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ston mdzad pa'i// chos rje bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing*// mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du// dam tshig can la dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brangs shing*// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs// sna tshogs phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi= /snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin// bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams// yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang*// bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i= /sgrub pa po la brten cing mchod pa dang*// skur pa 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa// thams cad byang chub lam la 'god (590)mdzad pa'i// mnyam med byang chub sems kyi= /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis go 'phang ji snyed yod pa rnams// phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du// skye 'gro yongs la rtag tu=

/bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin// snyan grags chen pos nam mkha' bzhin tu khyab// tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub// yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod do// yang dpal ldan lha mo phyag bzhi ma la mos na/ phyag g.yas na ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can dang gri gug /g.yon na la bu'i rgyal mtshan dang thod rlon 'dzin pa/ yang na phyag gnyis ma g.yas ral gri 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka la yang srin po'i ya mgal sga'i snga ru byas pa khroṃ baṃ dang*/ ma mgal phyi rur byas pa la nad rkyal btags pa/ sngags kyang phyag bzhi ma la/ oṃ ma ma sarba tsa dur bhak+ṣa dzaḥ re ma ti 'ur ba 'ur ba/ sa ma tri ra dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ phyag gnyis ma 'di la yang gong dkyus ltar gyi sngags dang*/ oṃ trag rag mo rak+ta ru dhi ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ bstod pa'i skabs su yang phyag gnyis ma la/ ral gri 'bar ba dang ni thod khrag 'dzin/ ces pa dang*/ phyag bzhi ma la ni// mthing nag sku la zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma// ral gri gri gug rgyal mtshan thod rlon 'dzin// zhes 'don pa spo/ las mkhan rnams kyang*/ k+ṣe tra pā la smug nag dang*/ dzi na mi tra cang te'u dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ ṭā k+ki rā dza cang te'u dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa dang*/ bdud mgon phyag bzhi pa/ mdung dmar beng chen tho ba thod khrag rnams 'dzin pa ltar byas kyang rung*/ yang dzi na mi tra g.yas rdzas kyi rdo rje pha lam dang*/ g.yon gcod pa'i 'khor lo 'phen pa'am ḍā ma ru dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ ṭā k+ki rā dza spu gri dang thod snying 'dzin pa ltar ram// gshin rje gri thod 'dzin pa ltar yang rung*// yang phyag mtshan dkyus ltar las// dzi na mi tra ljang gu dang*/ ṭā k+ki rā dza dmar po byas pa yang yod de/ de dag thams cad gang ltar byas kyang rung ba'o// las sbyor gyi tshe zhon pa can du bya ste/ nges par lha mo dang bdud mgon phyag bzhi par bya/

dzi na mi tra seng ge dang*/ ṭā k+ki rā dza stag la zhon pa/ phyag mtshan snga ma ltar ram/ spyang ki la chibs pa/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin par bsgoms la gtor ma 'bul ba yin no// 'khor rnams rgyas bar (591) bskyed ma nus na/ gtso bo'i mngon rtogs kyi rjes su 'khor rnams kyi mtshan tsam brjod pa'am/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ dpral bar oṃ zhes pa man chad bya/ gtor chog 'bring po ni/ 'khor mi bskyed par gtso rkyang bskyed nas spyan 'dren pa man chad bya/ mchod pa'i tshigs bcad rnams kyang dor bas 'grub cing*/ bsdus pa ni/ dam tshig pa mi bskyed par ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa yin te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal zhes sogs man chad bya ste// 'bring bsdus gnyis la gnad gsum gyi dmigs pa bor te gtor ma 'bul ba sogs bya'o// bsnyen pa'i dus ma yin pa rgyun gyi bzlas pa'i skabs kyang phal cher phyi ma 'di nyid gtso bor bzung ngo*// bdag bskyed ni/ spyir yi dam gang la brten kyang rung mod kyi/ gtso bor ni bde kye 'jigs byed rta mgrin rnams gang rung gcig la brten nas mdzad par snang ngo*// bdag mdun dbyer med du byed pa dang tha dad du byed kyang mgon po gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs 'di nyid dam// gsang sgrub rgyan can la brten pa sogs kyang man ngag khungs ma las kyang 'byung zhing*// lung rig dang 'gal ba med pa'i phyir shin tu rung mod kyi// 'on kyang las dang po pa rnams kyis dkyus ltar nyams su blangs na chog go /'dir smras pa// de ltar bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi// sgrub thabs mdor bsdus tsam zhig brjod pa 'di// dam pa snga ma rnams kyis yang nas yang*// gsal bar mdzad mod gzhan gyis bskul ba'i ngor// shin tu gsal zhing rgyas bsdus skyon bral bar// go bde'i tshig gis brjod na blo dman la// phan par 'gyur bas mos pa sna tshogs dang*// mtshungs pa'i rim pa so sor phye ba yin// dge des bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa la// bar chad kun zhi mthun rkyen kun 'grub nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa// da lta nyid du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams// skad cig tsam gyis tshar bcad de// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi// phrin las phyogs bcur spel bar shog /ces pa'ang mchog tu gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer bdun pa nag pa zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la legs par sbyar ba'o/
